title: Think Twice: Measuring the Efficiency of Eliminating Prediction Shortcuts of Question Answering Models

bias_targets.methodology: Segmenting evaluation data into two subsets based on specific spurious features (e.g., answer length, distance of question words from answer words, lexical overlap, answer position) using heuristics, and measuring the difference in model performance between the two groups using bootstrapped evaluation to quantify 'Prediction bias'.
